svg.title: European Tech Opportunities 2027 — repository overview
svg.desc: Configuration and the CLI drive permission-gated collection and a separate availability audit. Repository is the only application writer to canonical SQLite. The website, API, exports, and README are read-only projections. Automation, tests, documentation, policies, and build tooling support these boundaries.
